generationInputs.prompt: A modern CD jewel case, centered against a light gray background, showcases the cover art for a fictional pop album. The album insert features vibrant, contemporary vector artwork with a clean aesthetic and bold outlines, reflecting a playful and energetic mood with bright, contrasting colors and whimsical motifs. The central image is a stylized, polished, clear diamond with brilliant facets, around which white smoke or vapor swirls on the left, partially obscuring it. To the right of the diamond, a peach, an eggplant, and a clear plastic syringe with a light blue tip are positioned vertically. The syringe, rendered in simplified graphic form, contains a clear liquid with black measurement markings, and its thin metallic needle points upwards. The bold album title "you & me, and you, and you" is in a wide, rounded typeface, with "mega rush" as a subtitle. A fictional label name and logo, "bareback inter ff dld & lencería" are in one corner. The composition is polished and editorial, like a conceptual product photo.
